title.narrative: EU4Skills in Libya: Promoting Skills and Employability for Private Sector Development

description.narrative: The EU4Skills action will have the general objective of better aligning the skills of the Libyan workforce to the needs of the labour market, by promoting specific technical skills for private sector development and strengthening the capacities and services of key public institutions. The focus of the action will be on three specific areas: the blue/green economy, digitalisation and the financial sector.
